meta.name: dbt-versioning
meta.description: Load when task involves dbt model versioning, creating v2 of a model, or backward-compatible model changes. Covers versions YAML config, defined_in, latest_version, and ref() with version pins.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 dbt 模型版本配置与引用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 dbt 中创建或管理模型的多版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage dbt model versioning and references
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or manage multiple versions of dbt models

howto.what: 当需要为dbt模型创建新版本（如v2）或进行向后兼容修改时，Claude会使用dbt原生版本控制功能，通过配置versions YAML和正确命名文件来管理版本，并能使用ref()锁定指定版本。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建dbt模型的新版本（如v2）、进行向后兼容的改动或管理版本时触发。

say.text: 将这个模型的列名更改并作为版本2
say.note: Claude会基于原模型编写SELECT重命名
Claude会确保下游模型正确锁定版本

howto.what_en: After installation, when a task involves dbt model versioning, Claude uses native dbt versioning (versions config) to manage model versions, avoiding standalone _v2 files, and correctly uses ref() with version pins.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves creating a v2 of a dbt model, making backward-compatible changes, or managing model versions.

say_en.text: Create a v2 version of the dim_customers model
say_en.note: Claude will configure versions YAML and generate dim_customers_v2.sql

say_en.text: Rename a column in this model and make it version 2
say_en.note: Claude will write a SELECT with renames based on the original model

say_en.text: Use ref('dim_customers', v=2) to pin to version 2
say_en.note: Claude ensures downstream models lock the correct version
